_what: Trillion's own workspace shown live wherever it is described (src/showcases.mjs). Each visitor gets a throwaway account on `host`, its own address, so its sign-in never meets a real person's: the account reaches only the workspace routes minus `refused_paths` (each a path prefix, refused for every method but its `except_methods`: a screen may read what it shows, never change it), sends no email and runs no model (src/person-store.mjs), and empties itself `lifetime_minutes` after it starts. A showcase is one row of `showcases`: what the workspace opens on (`opens`, a workspace address), the tour that moves it (`tour`, the same DATA save_tour takes, with `play` so it moves by itself and each step's `look` choosing whether the page dims and blurs), its words for its page (`heading`, `body`), where to go next (`next`) and related showcases. A Marketplace tool with no row of its own gets one made from the tool (`tool_showcase`): its own screen, a tour that types its sample into its first box and points at its run button. Pages: `host`/<id> is the live workspace itself (embed it anywhere), app.gettrillion.ai/live/<id> is the page about it (`page_path`), and every Marketplace listing whose tool has a showcase shows it live. Adding a showcase is one row here. A row's `spare_accounts` keeps that many throwaway accounts already seeded for it, so a visitor's workspace starts at once; spares are prepared `spare_step_seconds` at a time after the live host answers, and one nobody took empties itself after `spare_hours`. How far a spare is prepared and who holds it are the `spare_facts`, kept in the spare's own records (src/showcase-spare-facts.mjs).

body.name: /Notes/workshop-plan.md
body.text:
# Design Systems for Small Teams

Four weeks, one live session a week, twelve seats.
Week 1: audit what the team already has. Week 2: tokens and type. Week 3: components. Week 4: handing it to developers.

Price: 390 or 590 euros? Past clients said they would pay up to 600. Need the October dates filled before I announce it.

body.name: /Notes/ferreira-coffee-kickoff.md
body.text:
# Ferreira Coffee kickoff

Inês wants the rebrand to feel like the roastery floor, warm and a bit worn in. Three directions for the logo by the 14th. She will share the old packaging photos in our pursuit.
She chose the middle tier of the proposal. The brief is next.

body.name: /Notes/studio-week.md
body.text:
# Studio notes

November overlaps two client projects and the workshop. I cannot run all of it alone. A part-time producer would take scheduling, invoices and the client emails. Ask Rita whether she knows anyone good.
